description:
**ATSP assignment cycle cover and greedy patching.** Use a finite complete directional matrix with nonnegative, representable costs. Solve the minimum-cost assignment after giving self arcs a cost larger than any complete unpenalized cover.

Pass the successor permutation to cycle decomposition and join distinct cycles by the least-increase swap of successors. Each swap reduces the cycle count. The final single cycle gives a legal open tour.

The assignment handles input arc directions. Patching is a greedy repair and can substantially increase the objective. The returned tour is a feasible upper bound for the given matrix.
